reason: Automates DeepSeek Harness tool-call approval by applying rules and an LLM classifier to allow or deny calls, with an optional UI for status and decision history.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 自动判断工具调用是允许还是拒绝，并提供可选的状态与决策记录界面。
summaries.en: Automatically determines whether DeepSeek Harness tool calls are allowed or denied, with an optional interface for status and decision history.

capabilities: Automatically classifies tool calls as allow or deny before execution
Dispatches whitelisted file operations and ls directly
Uses an L1 LLM classifier for some tool-call decisions
Provides a UI status chip, configuration summary, switch, statistics, and recent decisions
